name: updateLocationsAdvanced
description: Changes several locations at once, up to 50.

locations.description: The locations to change and what changes for each, up to 50 at a time.

locationId.description: The location's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The location's new title. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newSubtitle.description: The new subtitle. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAddress.description: The new address, given with its latitude and longitude. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newLatitude.description: The new address's latitude. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newLongitude.description: The new address's longitude. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newCustomName.description: The new name shown for the address on the map. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newDescription.description: The new description, as formatted text. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newListImage.description: The new picture shown in lists, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newImages.description: The location's pictures, in order; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them.

newCategories.description: Its categories, separated by commas, with a subcategory after an arrow, such as Food -> Pizza; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty to remove them.

newMarkerType.description: How the location is marked on the map. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newMarkerImage.description: The picture used as the map marker, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newMarkerColor.description: The color of the circle marker, such as rgba(253,35,5,1). Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newShowCategory.description: Whether its categories are shown. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

newShowOpeningHours.description: Whether its opening hours are shown. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

newShowPriceRange.description: Whether its price range is shown. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

newShowStarRating.description: Whether its star rating is shown. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

newPriceRange.description: How pricey it is. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newPriceCurrency.description: The currency sign shown with the price range. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newMondayHours.description: Monday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newTuesdayHours.description: Tuesday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newWednesdayHours.description: Wednesday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newThursdayHours.description: Thursday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newFridayHours.description: Friday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newSaturdayHours.description: Saturday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newSundayHours.description: Sunday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty for closed.

newActionItems.description: The location's actions, in order; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them.

callback.description: Runs when all the locations are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as an unknown location id.

locations.description: One result per location, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which location this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The location's id, if it was changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
